approval_ref: The active goal makes CRIP the local task and audit manager for an advanced-model reference implementation; durable execution reduces browser labor without authorizing a live benchmark.
notes: Add one durable managed execution session only after an explicit selected-source transfer and possible-provider-charge confirmation.
Reuse the existing frozen evaluation, QA V3 single-item execution, immutable result, safe terminal failure and unresolved-call ledger; do not create a second answer path.
Run one question at a time on CIRP's single worker, persist bounded progress and safe reason codes, and exclude competing model or analysis work.
Stop only after an in-flight question settles. Service interruption must never auto-resume an earlier confirmation; remaining questions require a newly confirmed job.
Keep single-question and browser-sequential execution available, and make no external model call during implementation or acceptance.

Implemented migration 014, one persisted global worker job, explicit true confirmation, exact frozen-profile and unresolved-call checks before every item, safe progress/reason state, stop-after-current, startup interruption, and mutual exclusion with analysis, semantic verification, model changes and all answer endpoints.

Validated 56 focused backend/browser/governance tests, 24 localization tests and the complete 1,515-test Python suite. Requirements=151, schemas=23, task context and change ledger pass; all model behavior was synthetic and no external provider call was made.
title: Durable explicitly confirmed Reference evaluation jobs
objective: Let an explicitly confirmed frozen Reference evaluation continue on CIRP's local single worker after the browser closes, with durable progress, global dispatch exclusion, stop-after-current, safe halts and no automatic resume or retry.
